value.rationale: The smallest nonclassical 111 and next 1111 parity words yield complete new involution-fixed factor languages, sharp cutoffs that jump from 14 to 30, exact per-factor rational occurrence frequencies, and unique state/residue occurrence descriptions for the maximal factors. This is a natural whole-word classification, not a routine finite prefix experiment.
